verdict.rationale: Solid ships Context as a built-in feature for sharing state through the component tree. Components are plain functions that you can organize freely, which supports modular building blocks and a tree-scoped form of dependency injection. The evidence frames Context mainly as global state management and gives no detail on provider/injection patterns. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Context as a dependency-injection mechanism (providers, scoped overrides, injecting services), and independent or hands-on corroboration of DI-style modular architecture.
